name: inkk-companion
description: inkk desktop companion: certifies what you write anywhere on your Mac, and checks the inkk codes in what you read.

scripts.test: node --test capture.test.js lib/sessions.test.js lib/codes.test.js lib/api.test.js lib/auth.test.js lib/lookup.test.js lib/docmeta.test.js lib/receiver.test.js lib/stamp.test.js lib/mark.test.js

extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: inkk reads the text in front, on this Mac, to fingerprint what you certify and to notice inkk codes in what you read. The text never leaves your Mac.
extendInfo.NSScreenCaptureUsageDescription: Only if you switch it on: inkk looks at the window in front, on this Mac, to read the inkk code in a signed name or a screenshot. Nothing is recorded or sent.
